<!-- pr-reviewer: 79091df9a067372b59730f53738d0fb8f3b2e589 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge**

Thanks for this, austin62jake. Docs-only (README.md plus a decision file), so nothing was built.

**What looks good**
- Machine list matches `posting::MACHINES` (crates/app/src/posting.rs:128-134): Tormach 770MX, 770MX (ML), 770M, 1100MX, 1500MX, PCNC 440, with all six `.mch` files present in assets/machines.
- "Tormach PathPilot" is the registered post name (posting.rs:39, assets/posts/tormach.cps).
- "Export setup sheets..." is the real button label on the Setups page (crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs:889), and posting does not render sheets (`render_all` is only reached from the setup-sheet command, state.rs:3636), so "Posting does not write them" is accurate. The old "prints alongside" claim is correctly removed.
- The README names the page ("the Setups page") without describing how to reach it, so it stays correct after #322/#324 made the page reachable from the ribbon and browser in a fresh document.
- Trial merge with current origin/main is clean (no conflicts). Markdown is well-formed; no contradiction with the experimental-warning block or Contributing sections. Decision file is in docs/decisions/ as the process requires.

**Local results merged with main**
Build/tests/clippy: not run (docs-only diff, no code touched).

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Body/commit hygiene (`Fixes #`, `Changelog:` line) was not something I could block on for a docs-only change.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
